old_findings.note: OZ 5's panic code still prints as 'Panic(uint256), 17 ^ 3 * (not d)' (4 lines: 535, 1156, 1172...).
Immutables still read as 0 (onlyBeforeSale always reverts, zero minimum balances).

regressions.source: LBPool.getLBPoolImmutableData: new uint256[](2) for startWeights/endWeights after decoding getPoolTokens/getTokenInfo results
regressions.issue: Addresses the old text gave relative to one mem[64] variable now spell out every earlier allocation (three array lengths and two return sizes), so stores, allocation checks and returned slices are much longer for the same meaning.
regressions.rule: When the free-memory pointer is written, bind its new value to one variable and print later addresses relative to that variable.

improvements: P1 8 -> 0 (25 * 10**13 * 3600 -> 9 * 10**17), P2 2 -> 0 (Vault totalSupply/getPoolConfig decoded), P6 2 -> 0. 9 return-copy loops are gone: getTokens, getCurrentLiveBalances, getMinTokenBalances and getTokenInfo return 'Array(len=..., data=...)', and getLBPoolImmutableData returns its struct. Bounds checks implied by a constant or dominating length were dropped (getMinTokenBalances 12 -> 6 reverts). The hook parameters are named by calldata word (onAfterAddLiquidity: _param4, _param5, _param7, _param8, skipping the unread uint256 at word 6). onSwap's lines after 'revert with InvalidToken()' are dropped and its if-chain flattened, with the same set of custom errors.
notes: The diff is 2660 lines; I checked all 14 changed functions with normalized per-function diffs (control flow, reverts by error, calls, loops, returns). All 4 source loops are still whiles (21 whiles: only return/copy loops were removed). The 600-line onSwap branch that needs tokenIndex outside {0..3} and below 2 was already unreachable, and is still printed. The pack header lists no P1-P6.
summary: No semantic regression. One low readability regression: some memory addresses are now long sums of earlier allocations. Improvements: decoded Vault calls, explicit array and struct returns, P1/P2/P6 gone, implied bounds checks and dead lines removed.
